candidate_filter: Training only: padj < 0.05 and baseMean > 100, as in Figure_2.ipynb.
discrepancy_note: The 2024 article reports 113 candidates, but its repository's exact training filter reproduces 142 with the audited inputs; the six saved marker statistics match. An exact 113-gene list was not found in the inspected article supplements. This reference reproduces the repository filter and does not certify the reported 113-gene set.

inputsource.training_analysis: Scripts_For_Manuscript/Figure_2.ipynb: training DESeq2 and candidate_genes cells

size_factor_method: Default DESeq2 ratio: exp(median(log(count) - rowMean(log(reference counts)))) over genes positive in every reference sample; do not geometrically center size factors.
normalization_scope: Pooled coefficients are for descriptive Figure 1C only. New ML comparisons freeze training geometric means and training coefficients for test/validation. The original Figure 2 notebook instead independently fitted VST for each split.
